title: Voicemail cadence scratch — Rohan
content:
Quick scratchpad for midday voicemails + follow-up sequencing. Raw, messy — do not share as-is.

Goals for today: 
- clear 8 cold VMs, 5 warm follow-ups. prioritize Dedicated and Private prospects who asked about latency/cost.
- convert 1 demo meeting for late March (time zone: PST preferred).

1) Priority accounts (call order) — notes + next step
- VelaHealth (AE outreach 2x) — CTO unresponsive. Yesterday left long VM: "VelaHealth — Rohan from Redwood. 2 min on why we reduce inference cost 3x for batch reports. Email sent. Call back x." Action: follow-up email with 1-slide ROI, ask for 20-min sync. 
- AtlasMsg (warm) — trial usage low, token burn spike flagged. Ask SRE to attach perf report before demo. Action: VM + send perf snippet, propose Wed 3/18 10am PT.
- GreenLedger (cold) — likely compliance concern. Short VM: offer private deployment brief + PCI/HIPAA note. Action: attach compliance one-pager.

2) Voicemail scripts / options (keep <25s)
- Standard cold: "Hi <name>, Rohan at Redwood Inference. We help apps run LLMs cheaper and with predictable latency — I have a quick note on lowering per-token cost for inference pipelines. Sent an email with ROI; 415-555-XXXX — would love 10 minutes next week."
- Warm + Emailed: "Hi <name>, quick follow-up on the email I sent about reducing latency for your summarization job. I can share a short report and a demo — what does Thurs morning look like?"
- Compliance-first: "Hi <name>, Rohan from Redwood. We do private deployments and VPC integrations for regulated workloads. Sent a compliance one-pager to your team — happy to walk through details."

3) Cadence matrix (VM + email + LinkedIn touch) — testing sequence for PW1 (trial users)
- Day 0: Email (intro + ROI slide)
- Day 2: Voicemail (short script + call to action)
- Day 4: LinkedIn connection + one-line note
- Day 8: Break-up email (2 sentence, value reminder)
Metrics to watch: reply rate after VM, demo conversion within 14 days, reduction in trial churn.

4) Quick qualifying questions to ask on demo / call
- Primary workload: chat vs batch generation vs embeddings?
- Peak sequence lengths and token mix (summary vs long context)?
- Current infra: hosted third-party API vs in-house serving? SLA needs?
- Cost sensitivity: what percent of infra budget could be reallocated if we cut per-token costs by 30%?

5) Email subject line ideas to A/B
- "Short: Cut LLM inference spend by ~30% (ROI inside)"
- "Private deployment option for regulated workloads — quick brief"
- "Demo: 20-minute perf walkthrough for your summarization jobs"

6) Quick follow-up checklist after leaving VM
- [ ] Send tailored ROI slide (one pager)
- [ ] Add follow-up task to CRM + set reminder 3 days
- [ ] CC SE if prospect mentioned token limits or quantization questions
- [ ] Check trial usage dashboard; screenshot peak token rate

7) Notes to self — experiments to run this week
- Try A/B voicemail length (15s vs 30s) and track reply delta
- Test including sentence about "fallback to smaller model variants" in email to reduce FUD about quality
- Coordinate with DevRel for a short notebook showing cost/latency tradeoffs for common SDK calls

8) Rapid-hit responses / rebuttals for common objections
- "We already use X provider": "Totally — many teams keep X for experiments. Redwood is focused on predictable serving economics for production; can be complementary."
- "We can’t move off-prem": "We offer a private deployment option that works inside your VPC and supports KMS; happy to loop in infra."

Random notes / todo (brief)
- Ping SE team about AtlasMsg perf report (done)
- Draft compliance one-pager for GreenLedger (add HIPAA checklist)
- Add new voicemail template variants to playbook page

End of scratch. Next update: move any converted demos to calendar and mark CRM stage = demo-scheduled.

Timestamp: last edits 2026-03-13 09:12 PT
